title: Russia’s Hybrid War Has Entered a Dangerous New Phase

Request reprint permissions here.For the first few years of the war in Ukraine, Russia’s hybrid warfare attacks in Europe remained just below the threshold that might trigger a collective response. As the United States’ permanent representative to NATO from 2021 to 2024, I watched the campaign develop: undersea cables cut, incendiary devices hidden in cargo packages, and arson attacks on weapons factories and depots across Europe. To address the threat, allies reinforced critical infrastructure, increased patrols in the Baltic Sea, and expanded intelligence sharing.
